name: tai_chi
text: A person practices a short slow tai chi cloud-hands sequence. Stand in a wide bent-knee stance, shift weight smoothly left then right while both open hands trace alternating circular arcs across the front of the torso. One hand rises to chest height as the other lowers near the waist, then exchange. Calm continuous rounded movement with a gentle torso turn, no punches.
hand_paths: opposed rounded arcs between waist and chest in front of torso

review.notes_zh: 缓慢换重心配合双手上下交替画圆，手部轨迹约束在腰胸之间；第二版纠正首版双手过高。为可辨的太极式片段，非整套拳法或教学动作。
